minutes.summary: The Finance Committee debriefed the town's first tri-board meeting on consolidation and financial best practices, and discussed standardizing department budget presentations through a new submission portal. Much of the meeting focused on ongoing concerns about the school department's financial transparency and lack of a finance manager, with a member reporting new outreach from the incoming superintendent; minutes were approved and the meeting adjourned.

what_happened.line: The committee agreed to adopt the ClearGov platform so town and school departments submit budget requests in a standard format.
Members again raised concerns about the school department's financial transparency and its lack of a finance manager, with a member reporting new outreach to the incoming superintendent.
The committee set a plan to review the town's finance policy document section by section, aiming to vote on it by around September.
Minutes from two prior meetings were approved, with one abstention.
A reorganization meeting was set for August, along with a recurring pattern of meetings to prep for and debrief each tri-board session.

why_it_matters: A standardized budget-submission portal would change how residents and other boards can compare department requests across town and school budgets.
Continued questions about school department transparency and staffing touch how the school budget -- the largest item on the town's warrant -- gets reported and reviewed going forward.
The finance policy document, once voted on in sections, would set rules the town follows in future budget decisions.
